content:
If you're like me, you've probably spent hours on Wikipedia just clicking around, reading random articles. Now, finally, there's an official app — err, widget — that lets you do just that.

There's finally a button that takes you directly to a random Wikipedia article.

Today's Wikipedia iOS app update adds a fun and useful new feature: a "random article" widget that you can place on your iPhone and iPad home screens.

It comes in two sizes (large and medium) and features a cute mascot.

Tap the widget and it will take you to a completely random Wikipedia article, opening in random mode for you.

No need to leave the app and tap the widget again — just hit the random button and it'll take you deeper and deeper into this random maze, like rolling dice.

Have fun, but be careful not to lose track of time while reading! Earlier this summer, the Wikipedia app also added a history trivia mini-game.

After you update the Wikipedia iPhone and iPad app today, you'll be able to find this new widget.

Make the most of your Apple devices!
